name: Kingdom of Prussia (1701–1750)
description: A white field with the black Prussian eagle, crowned, holding a sceptre and orb and bearing the royal monogram 'FR' on its breast.
history: State flag of the Kingdom of Prussia from its creation on 18 January 1701, when Elector Frederick III of Brandenburg was crowned Frederick I, King in Prussia: the black eagle of Prussia on white, with the crown and the monogram of the king. The eagle was redrawn in 1750.

features.role: crowned Prussian eagle with sceptre, orb and 'FR' monogram
